verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no statement that customer data is excluded from model training. The BYOD claim of running Sai on your own device "with control and privacy" and the model-agnostic choice of planning model are adjacent privacy features, not a control that stops your data being used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
